data.text:
The five-second epistemology of the chokepoint that doesn’t exist.

The chokepoint does not exist. Bessent said it. The chokepoint that we believe does not exist. The DFL at an all-time high in twenty-six years of data does not exist. The toll booth collecting in yuan does not exist. The parliament legislating the fees does not exist. Lloyd’s List reporting Tehran’s toll booth controlling all Hormuz traffic does not exist. The zero transits through the normal route since March 15 do not exist. The ships paying clearance codes to the IRGC do not exist. The mines do not exist. The architecture’s own president said we don’t know if there are mines. The mines that don’t exist in the chokepoint that doesn’t exist. The chokepoint does not exist therefore the Strait is open. The chokepoint does not exist therefore Slovenia isn’t rationing. The chokepoint does not exist therefore the Philippines didn’t declare a national energy emergency. The chokepoint does not exist therefore Shell didn’t say Europe faces shortages next month. The chokepoint does not exist therefore Hapag-Lloyd isn’t exploring options to rescue its own team from the chokepoint that doesn’t exist.

We will overcome. The architecture that hit 10,000 targets and the Strait is still closed will overcome. The architecture whose navy destroyed 92% of the thing that doesn’t control the Strait will overcome. The architecture negotiating with bombs that negotiated the Strait closed will overcome. The architecture at 36% approval will overcome. The architecture whose 800 Patriots lasted five days will overcome. The architecture adding corn and corroded pipes will overcome. We shall overcome. The hymn. The civil rights hymn repurposed by the Treasury Secretary for a chokepoint he says doesn’t exist. We shall overcome the thing that isn’t there. The architecture overcoming nothing. By definition.

Ghalibaf da Gangsta asked if they can print gas molecules. Can they print a chokepoint that doesn’t exist. Can they print the nonexistence of the thing that is choking. Can they print we will overcome the thing we believe isn’t there. The belief exists therefore the chokepoint doesn’t. The therefore that doesn’t therefore. Some chokepoint. Some belief. Some overcome. Some doesn’t exist. Day 27.
